text:
auditor_alex: Hi all, auditing team requesting artifacts for: service-account key rotation evidence, RoleBinding modification detection, and end-to-end vuln triage for CVE-2024-9999. Need chain-of-custody and control mapping for SOC2.

jess-sec: Quick list: KMS key metadata snapshots (alias:alias/infra-keys), CloudTrail RotateKey events, signed rotation-manifest (ops GPG), and HSM audit export if applicable.

auditor_alex: For RBAC changes, show that edits generate an alert + runbook. Where do we get a sample?

rick-k8s: k8s-audit -> forwarded to ELK. Detection rule: rolebinding change by non-admin svcacc triggers security.alert.rbac. Elastic example: `event.type:authorization OR verb:update AND objectRef.resource:rolebindings AND NOT user.username:infra-admins`

toni-ops: PagerDuty incident created, ticket contains the audit payload and a presigned s3 snapshot. We keep SHA256 manifest and a separate signature file.

auditor_alex: Need anonymized sample ticket & the exported artifacts. Also a redaction-friendly audit snippet and how manifests are signed.

jess-sec: Manifest creation: `./infra-tools rotation --key alias/infra-keys --out manifest.json` then `gpg --batch --yes --default-key ops@redwood.com --detach-sign manifest.json`. Store both in s3://redwood-compliance/rotations/2025/.

rick-k8s: Redact snippet: `kubectl get --raw /apis/audit.k8s.io/v1/events | jq '.items[] | select(.metadata.creationTimestamp>="2025-03-10T09:00:00Z" and .objectRef.resource=="rolebindings") | del(.requestObject.userEmail, .requestObject.headers, .userAgent)' > rbac_snip.json`

toni-ops: I'll export one anonymized PD ticket + the incident timeline (redacted) and put a zip in s3://redwood-audits/tmp/6136001234_sample.zip.

auditor_alex: For the CVE triage, list artifacts and timeline.

jess-sec: Triage artifacts: IDS alert, Jenkins PR/commit, deploy logs, canary metrics, postmortem doc, Slack incident channel transcript. Timeline example: detected 2025-03-10T09:12Z, triage 09:20Z, fix PR 10:05Z, merge & deploy 11:40Z, canary verified 12:15Z, full rollout 13:00Z, postmortem 2025-03-17.

auditor_alex: Control mapping?

jess-sec: We'll attach csv mapping to SOC2: CC6.1 (change mgmt), CC7.2 (access controls), CC8.3 (monitoring). File will include control_id, artifact_path, owner, retention.

auditor_alex: Can you produce a Splunk snapshot for +/- 7 days around the event?

toni-ops: Yes, we keep 90-day hot logs. Provide query and we'll export with hashed filenames.

redwood-pd-bot: pagerduty: Incident 483721 created (incident:rbac) - status: acknowledged.

auditor_alex: Thanks, please post presigned links when ready. We'll review the manifest sig and CSV and loop back with follow-ups.

jess-sec: Will upload bundle to s3://redwood-audits/audits/2025/Q1/alex_bundle_6136001234.zip and DM presigned link.

auditor_alex: Received, appreciate the fast turnaround. Closing for now. :thumbsup:
